Sunday Canyon to Canyon (Channel Islands Bicycle Club)

Ventura, CA · Saticoy · Road

Sunday Canyon to Canyon (Channel Islands Bicycle Club) is a road group ride in Ventura, CA. It rolls every Sunday at 8:00 am from Hobert Park, Saticoy. About 32 miles, 16-18 mph average; the club says this group is faster than normal.

For visitors

Guests must complete the club's CIBike Guest Signup & Waiver before riding. The group rides faster than normal, so download the route before you join.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16-18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sunday Canyon to Canyon (Channel Islands Bicycle Club) group ride

A Sunday ride from Hobert Park in Saticoy through Aliso and Wheeler Canyons to historic downtown Santa Paula, 32 miles at a 16 to 18 mph average. Food at Rabalais' Bakery before the ride back. The club says the group is faster than normal and asks guests to download the route first.
